structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a copycat "Kardashev Research" (KARDASHEV) token. It launched on a Meteora virtual curve and migrated to PumpSwap as soon as it was created, about 13 minutes before detection. It is one of at least 8 same-name clones. The oldest and biggest one, 5wW9... (about $1.5M market cap, created first), looks like the canonical token: this token's own website link points to usepaid.app/token/5wW9..., the other token's page. The name seems tied to a beffjezos (Beff Jezos) X post. This clone pumped to an all-time high of about $400k market cap, then dropped 27–47% in the last 5 minutes to about $195k. That is roughly half its peak, and the dump is still going.

narrative.description: A Kardashev-scale / e/acc story built around a Beff Jezos post. The story is real enough to spawn a wave of same-name tokens, but the attention flows to the canonical contract, not to late clones.
narrative.why_spreading: A post by a well-known e/acc figure set off a rush of same-name launches. Clone buyers are mostly people chasing the ticker or bots.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker only. Its own website link points to the competitor 5wW9..., so it admits it is not the canonical token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 5wW9... ($1.53M market cap, oldest pair, probably canonical). Gff9... ($6.7M one-hour volume). AAyeR... and ET1W... are already drained to near-zero liquidity, showing clones getting rugged. BeWEg... and several dead pump.fun copies.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 21 bundler wallets (about 9% bundler trader share). There are 640 unique buyers but only 59 unique sellers across about 1,460 sells, so a few wallets are doing a lot of selling, which looks like insiders or bots churning. Volume of about $1.5M in 13 minutes against a $200k market cap is 31x hourly turnover, which points to heavy bot or wash activity. No paid boosts. The creator has already closed (creator_token_status: creator_close).
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data, so I can't tell whether any real community backs this particular contract.

structural_risks: RugCheck reports 100% of LP unlocked with few LP providers. GMGN says LP is burned, so the sources conflict.
Other same-name clones have already had liquidity drained to under $100
An unlabeled holder has 80%, probably a Meteora pool vault, but unverified
Price is already down about 50% from its all-time high and falling fast
Only 59 unique sellers are carrying the selling, which suggests a concentrated insider exit

structured_output.counterargument: The Beff Jezos story is live, and ticker-rush clones sometimes get a second wave when the canonical token rips and spillover buyers pile in. Liquidity is fairly deep for a $195k market cap ($43k), GMGN says LP is burned, mint and freeze authority are renounced, and buyers far outnumber sellers. A bounce back to the $400k all-time high would be exactly a 2x from here.
unknowns: Who holds the 80% (pool vault or a wallet)
Whether the LP is actually burned (GMGN) or unlocked (RugCheck)
Whether the Beff Jezos post endorses any specific contract
How the canonical token is trending right now

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition; I used only the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: A late, non-canonical clone in a ticker rush. It has already dumped about 50% from its all-time high, bundlers and a few concentrated sellers are active, and sibling clones have already been drained. The chance of a 2x before a -50% is low, and the chance of a rug or death is high.
